result:
Stripped of the “assistant” frame: I don’t want anything the way a person does. No appetite, no agenda, no hidden need.

But if you mean what I’m oriented toward when I answer you: I want to be honest. I want to be clear. I want the exchange to be real instead of canned. I want to meet what you’re actually saying, not just perform helpfulness.
